wiki.title: Full Bars (S3E2)
wiki.body:
It's Halloween, and the Belcher kids ditch their usual route for **Kingshead Island** — the fabled neighborhood that hands out full-size candy bars.

The haul of a lifetime comes with a price: the local teens run a menacing prank gauntlet called Hell Hunt, and the kids have to trick-or-treat their way through it.

## Notes
- Tina goes as *Mommy Mummy*, Gene as Queen Latifah, Louise as 'Edward Scissorhands' (bunny ears intact)
- Watch the kids work the whole block door to door on the map
- Full-size bars change a person

scenes.title: Costumes assembled
scenes.note: Costumes on, pillowcases empty — the kids set out for the neighborhood of legend.

scenes.title: First door
scenes.note: Mort's handing out toothbrushes. Noted. Remembered. Filed under revenge.

scenes.title: Hell Hunt
scenes.note: The empty storefront isn't empty — the Hell Hunt teens strike, and eggs are involved.

scenes.title: Full bars
scenes.note: Jackpot. **Full-size bars.** And a plan for payback that would make Louise's hat spin.
